channel.title: Late Brake blog
channel.description: Formula 1 news, history, fun facts and what happened on this day.

item.title: On this day: Schumacher equals record, Hamilton takes fourth title
item.description: On 29 October, Michael Schumacher equalled the record for wins in a season in 1995, and Max Verstappen won twice in Mexico, in 2017 and 2023.

item.title: F1 Mexico City Grand Prix 2026: race time in India and full schedule
item.description: The F1 Mexico City Grand Prix starts at 1:30am on Monday in India. Here is every session in India time, and why Kimi Antonelli could be crowned champion.

item.title: Perez signs new Cadillac deal to stay until 2029
item.description: Sergio Perez has extended his contract with Cadillac until at least 2029, days before his 300th Grand Prix start at his home race in Mexico.

item.title: Antonelli wins US Grand Prix to move two points from the title
item.description: Kimi Antonelli led from pole to win his ninth race of 2026 and can become Formula 1's youngest world champion in Mexico on Sunday.

item.title: On this day: Vettel wins in India, Hamilton crowned in Mexico
item.description: On 28 October, Sebastian Vettel won the 2012 Indian Grand Prix from pole, and Lewis Hamilton clinched his fifth world title in Mexico in 2018.

item.title: The rise and fall of the Indian Grand Prix
item.description: For three years, Formula 1 raced at the Buddh International Circuit near Delhi. Sebastian Vettel won every race. Then a tax dispute ended it.

item.title: Five F1 facts that sound made up, but are true
item.description: A Grand Prix that lasted one lap, a race with six cars and India's first points. Five true stories from Formula 1 history.
